subject: prd/tech-design-review
statement: When invoked, the reviewer shall verify its subject — a post-lint draft design, with its solution-shape when one exists, or a superseding design with its target(s) — and shall refuse any other subject naming the state and remedy, writing nothing.
fit_criterion: fixtures: draft, pair, and supersession admitted; pre-lint, shape-without-design, and non-design refused with remedies, zero writes
